title: Overview.
tagline: From the schema to the screen
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer from Islamabad. At GalvanAI I joined on contract in November 2025 and moved to a full-time role in February 2026. Today I build multi-tenant SaaS platforms end to end.

Outside work I ship complete apps, not demos: each one has CI, versioned releases and documentation on GitHub. I care about software that's secure by design, code the next developer can pick up easily, and finishing what I start.

highlights.title: Full-stack SaaS
highlights.text: Next.js, FastAPI and PostgreSQL, with auth, roles, organizations and Stripe billing.

highlights.title: AI products
highlights.text: LLM apps, voice AI and agents with OpenAI, Gemini and Twilio.

highlights.title: Mobile
highlights.text: Flutter and Firebase apps for Android, released as signed APKs.

highlights.title: Shipping
highlights.text: Docker, GitHub Actions, Terraform for AWS, Nginx and VPS hosting.
